thread:
anya: Quick heads-up: planning a blue->green traffic shift for service-recs (eu-west-1) tomorrow 2026-03-23 01:00 UTC. Plan: shadow prewarm 3% -> canaries 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100%. Drain 120s between steps. Abort/rollback on criteria below. Any blockers?
lee: ack. Which cookie strategy are we using? sticky via router cookie?
routerops: yes, router cookie pinning will carry across, but we need to ensure cookie format compatibility between blue/green.
anya: good call. we'll do a compatibility grep in logs pre-shift. Runbook: (A) prewarm shadow 3% for 10m to fill caches, (B) run smoke suite, (C) proceed with canaries.
deploy-bot: scheduled run shift-20260323-0100 for service-recs eu-west-1. Command: `/shift run --id shift-20260323-0100 --steps 1,5,20,100 --drain 120s --shadow 3 --auto-rollback true`
ops-oncall: I'm on rotation 00:50-02:00 UTC. Assign to me for the window.
lee: adding observability checks: p95, latency trend, 5xx rate, error budget burn, cookie mismatch logs, and downstream embedding queue depth.
anya: rollback triggers: p95 > 300ms sustained 5m OR 5xx > 1% sustained 3m OR cookie-mismatch logs spike OR SLO alerted. Manual abort allowed.
routerops: routerctl snippet we'll use:
```
routerctl weight service-recs green 1 && sleep 120
routerctl weight service-recs green 5 && sleep 120
routerctl weight service-recs green 20 && sleep 120
routerctl weight service-recs green 100
```
(deploy-bot will orchestrate)
deploy-bot: step1 complete: green 1% (ts 1717810140). Metrics: p95=74ms, 5xx=0.05%, cookie-errors=0.
anya: ok proceed to 5% in 5m.
deploy-bot: step2 complete: green 5% (ts 1717810300). Metrics: p95=80ms, 5xx=0.2%, smoke tests passed.
lee: noticed a tiny rise in cookie-format warnings in app logs. tagging #cookie-format. Not user-facing yet but watchful.
deploy-bot: step3 initiated: shifting to 20% (ts 1717810460).
deploy-bot: ALERT: 5xx spiked to 3.4% in last 2m, auto-rollback triggered. Rolling back to blue 100% (rb id rb-20260323-0100) (ts 1717810505).
ops-oncall: confirmed rollback completed; routing back to blue 100%. Created incident INC-20260323-01 and uploaded traces: s3://redwood-incidents/2026/03/23/recs-shift-0100.
anya: investigating. early hypothesis: cookie-compatibility issue between blue (v2.1) and green (v2.2) session serializer.
lee: I can reproduce: if a cookie with new serializer hits old codepath we get 5xx NPEs. Patch incoming to add defensive decode.
routerops: will hold further rollouts until compatibility is confirmed.
deploy-bot: note: shadow prewarm did not uncover cookie decode failures because shadow traffic bypasses older cookie paths. We should extend shadow verification to include cookie roundtrips.
anya: agreed. action items: (1) add model/session version gate to deploy-bot to prevent mixed-serializer shifts, (2) extend shadow prewarm verification to assert cookie decode/encode parity, (3) update runbook and release notes to mention cookie-format compatibility and prewarm checks. I'll open PRs for runbook and release note updates and will schedule a retry once fixes are live. Thanks all :+1:
lee: will also add a short grep in preflight: `grep -E \"cookie_serializer_v2.2|cookie_error\" /var/log/app/*` and fail pre-check if matches.
ops-oncall: tagging follow-up oncall rotation to review incident tomorrow.
anya: thanks team. closing this thread for now — will post retry plan once patches land.
